Macrons

Consonantal i

Consonantal u

Theme

Civic life: news, government & the law

majesty noun

also grandeur, greatness, sovereign dignity, the majesty of the Roman people

classical

Cic. Phil. 3.13: majestātem populī Rōmānī dēfendere (Lewis & Short)
Sall. Jug. 14.25: per majestātem populī Rōmānī subvenīte miserō mihi (Lewis & Short)

majestās, majestātis f.

noun, third declension

greatness, grandeur, dignity: of the gods, of the Roman people, of men in high office

Examples

  • per majestātem populī Rōmānī subvenīte miserō mihi

    by the majesty of the Roman people, come to my help in my miserySall. Jug. 14.25 (Lewis & Short)

See also dignity, treason.
